review:
The concept of the movie, a serial killer trying to escape a pop concert that is set as a trap, and so is full of cops, is an interesting one, but it falls short on the execution.

My biggest gripe with the movie is that the performances, conversations and situations that happen, all feel a bit too cartoony, that is, they don`t feel so consequential and seems to always work in favor of the main character.

The story tries to take itself serious, but I wasn't able to do the same.
